reason: policy heritage-core-default permits fill (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:58709 — Every field this deployment's capabilities fill is a search field on a query form — member number, account number — and filling one commits nothing on its own. It is classified risky because a value typed into the wrong box is how a transfer acquires the wrong payee, and because the values are member data. reason: policy heritage-core-default permits click (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:58709 — Clicking is how a search is submitted and how an account is opened from a member's list, and there is no way to read a balance out of Heritage Core without doing both. That is a property of the approved artifacts rather than of this line, which is why the artifacts are reviewed and versioned.

subject: link "Primary Savings" within "Share and Deposit Accounts"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits selectFromList (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:58709 — A selection reads the items a screen is currently offering and presses the one whose label matches the parameter, so it commits exactly what a click commits and is classified the same way. It is permitted because the alternative is recording one artifact per account type, which multiplies the number of documents a reviewer has to approve without reducing what any of them can do. What bounds it is that the match is a token subset of a label the screen itself offered, never a free-text instruction: a selection cannot reach a control the list does not contain, and an ambiguous match stops the run rather than choosing.
